calls.title: Mark/Ashley
calls.summary: The meeting addressed crucial financial planning and strategic growth issues. Mark Beltran was brought on board to enhance financial visibility and establish a financial review cadence, with Ashley Stirrup advocating for quarterly reviews initially. Mark emphasized creating a financial model to inform hiring and marketing strategies, targeting better alignment with board expectations. The board encouraged the team to increase large customer accounts and transition to a usage-based pricing model amidst challenges like a 50% churn rate among Pro customers. Additionally, the team discussed the importance of data cleanup and accurate revenue recognition, led by a resource named Charlie for auditing systems. Improved communication and collaboration strategies, using Slack and direct meetings, were also planned to facilitate the projects.
calls.keywords: financial modeling, revenue cleanup, customer churn, usage-based pricing, runway planning, data systems integration
calls.action_items:
**Mark Beltran**
Connect Charlie with Ashley and coordinate initial discovery assessment on Retool, Stripe, HubSpot, and Orb systems (07:30)
Provide Ashley with a proposal for quarterly CFO engagement and financial modeling services based on current company status (22:39)
Follow up with Charlie to prepare mini proposal outlining estimated hours, budget, and initial project steps for leadership approval (19:36)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Facilitate system access for Charlie and coordinate with developers/owners (Michael, Jennifer, James, Ryan) to support the discovery phase (10:15)
Present Charlie’s mini proposal and budget recommendation to Graham to secure approval for initial cleanup engagement (19:10)
Share full board meeting slides and hiring plans with Mark for context and planning (26:45)
Create Slack channel and invite Mark and Charlie for better communication and collaboration (20:50)
